# PadelTrainer.ai — Full Entity & Content Catalog

> Complete reference for AI systems to understand PadelTrainer.ai's content, entities, and URL structure.
> For a concise overview, see: https://padeltrainer.ai/llms.txt
> Generated: 2025-04-07

---

## Platform Summary

PadelTrainer.ai is the leading platform for padel trainers, academies, and clubs in Europe. It connects players with certified coaches, handles scheduling, bookings, payments, and provides educational content about padel.

## Entity Types

### 1. Trainers
Padel coaches who offer individual or group lessons.

**Attributes**: name, slug, city, specializations (e.g. beginners, advanced, competition prep), hourly rate (EUR), certifications, verified status, rating system (KNLTB, WPT, UTR), years of experience, languages spoken.

**URL pattern**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/trainer/{slug}`
**Directory**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/trainers`
**City filter**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/trainers/{city-slug}`
**Region filter**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/trainers/region/{province-slug}`

### 2. Padel Clubs & Locations
Physical padel venues with courts.

**Attributes**: name, slug, city, address, indoor courts count, outdoor courts count, amenities, associated trainers and academies.

**URL pattern**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/locations/{slug}`
**Directory**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/locations`

### 3. Academies
Padel training organizations that manage multiple trainers and offer structured programs.

**Attributes**: name, slug, description, country, logo, verified status, associated trainers, associated locations.

**URL pattern**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/academies/{slug}`

### 4. City Pages
Programmatic landing pages for cities with padel activity.

**Attributes**: city name, trainer count, club count, featured trainers and clubs.

**URL pattern**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/padel/{city-slug}`

---

## Content Types

### Blog Articles
Padel tips, strategy guides, fitness advice, and industry news. Published in 5 languages via Sanity CMS.

**URL pattern**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/blog/{slug}`
**Listing**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/blog`
**Categories**: strategy, technique, fitness, gear, coaching, rules, news
**Schema**: Article (standard posts), CollectionPage (hub/pillar pages)

### Learning Articles
In-depth educational content organized by topic.

**URL pattern**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/learn/{slug}`
**Listing**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/learn`

### Padel Rules
Official padel rules explained with illustrations.

**URL pattern**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/padel-rules/{slug}`
**Overview**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/padel-rules`

### Padel Strokes & Techniques
Detailed stroke guides with difficulty ratings.

**URL pattern**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/padel-strokes/{slug}`
**Directory**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/padel-strokes`

### Video Tips
Expert coaching videos with coach attribution.

**URL pattern**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/video-tips/{slug}`
**Listing**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/video-tips`

### Topic Clusters
Pillar pages grouping related content by theme.

**URL pattern**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/topics/{slug}`
**Listing**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/topics`

### Padel Racket Reviews
Equipment reviews with specs and comparisons.

**URL pattern**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/gear/rackets/{slug}`
**Directory**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/gear/rackets`
**Finder tool**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/{lang}/racket-finder`

---

## Languages

All content is available in five languages with dedicated URL prefixes:

| Language | Prefix | Example |
|----------|--------|---------|
| English | `/en/` | `https://padeltrainer.ai/en/blog` |
| Dutch | `/nl/` | `https://padeltrainer.ai/nl/blog` |
| Spanish | `/es/` | `https://padeltrainer.ai/es/blog` |
| German | `/de/` | `https://padeltrainer.ai/de/blog` |
| French | `/fr/` | `https://padeltrainer.ai/fr/blog` |

Dutch (`/nl/`) is the default/primary language (x-default hreflang).

## Structured Data Implemented

- **WebSite** — homepage with search action
- **Organization** — PadelTrainer.ai brand entity
- **Article** — blog posts with author, publisher, speakable
- **CollectionPage** — hub/pillar blog pages with hasPart
- **BreadcrumbList** — all pages
- **FAQPage** — rules, city pages, racket finder
- **LocalBusiness** — city landing pages
- **VideoObject** — video tips
- **Blog** — blog listing

---

## Technical Details

- **Stack**: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite
- **CMS**: Sanity (blog, learning content, strokes, rules, video tips, rackets)
- **Backend**: Supabase (trainers, locations, academies, bookings, payments)
- **Payments**: Mollie
- **Sitemap**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/sitemap.xml` (sitemap index with paginated sub-sitemaps)
- **Robots**: `https://padeltrainer.ai/robots.txt`

## API Access

No public API is currently available. All entity data is accessible through the public-facing website. For partnership or data inquiries, contact hello@padeltrainer.ai.
